tasks.name: רק זוגיים
tasks.note: Keeps only the even elements.

tasks.name: שניים אחרונים
tasks.note: Keeps the last two elements.

tasks.name: קטנים מ-12
tasks.note: Keeps elements below 12.

tasks.name: סיבוב ימינה
tasks.note: Moves the last element to the front.

tasks.name: מקומות אי-זוגיים
tasks.note: Keeps elements at odd positions.

tasks.name: מיון יורד
tasks.note: Sorts the list in descending order.

tasks.name: כפולות 3
tasks.note: Keeps the multiples of three.

tasks.name: בלי שניים אחרונים
tasks.note: Drops the last two elements.

tasks.name: קצוות
tasks.note: Keeps only the first and last elements.

tasks.name: מינימום לסוף
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const m=Math.min(...l); return [...l.filter(x=>x!==m),m]; }
tasks.note: Moves the smallest element to the end.

tasks.name: מיון לפי ביטים
tasks.note: Sorts by number of set bits, then by value.

tasks.name: מיון שארית 5
tasks.note: Sorts by remainder modulo 5, then by value.

tasks.name: גדול מהבא
tasks.note: Keeps elements larger than their successor, plus the last one.

tasks.name: לפני המינימום
tasks.note: Keeps the elements before the smallest one.

tasks.name: היפוך שלשות
tasks.note: Reverses each consecutive block of three.

tasks.name: נציג לכל זוג
tasks.note: Keeps the first element of each value pair 8-9, 10-11, 12-13, 14-15.

tasks.name: שארית 4 קטנה
tasks.note: Keeps elements whose remainder modulo 4 is 0 or 1.

tasks.name: גדולים קודם
tasks.note: Moves elements of at least 12 before the rest, keeping order.

tasks.name: בלי השני בגודלו
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return [...l]; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a); return l.filter(x=>x!==s[1]); }
tasks.note: Removes the second largest element.

tasks.name: ערך ומקום
tasks.note: Keeps elements whose value plus index is even.

tasks.name: כל שלישי מהסוף
tasks.note: Keeps every third element counting back from the last.

tasks.name: יורד בדילוג
tasks.note: Sorts descending and keeps every other element.

tasks.name: בין זוגיים
tasks.src: l=>{ const i=l.findIndex(x=>x%2===0); if(i<0) return []; let j=l.length-1; while(l[j]%2) j--; return l.slice(i,j+1); }
tasks.note: Keeps the span from the first even element to the last even element.

tasks.name: שני מעברי בחירה
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; for(let p=0;p<2&&p<r.length;p++){ let m=p; for(let i=p+1;i<r.length;i++) if(r[i]<r[m]) m=i; const t=r[p]; r[p]=r[m]; r[m]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: Runs two passes of selection sort.

tasks.name: ריצה עולה ארוכה
tasks.src: l=>{ let bs=0, bl=0, s=0; for(let i=0;i<=l.length;i++){ if(i===l.length||(i>0&&l[i]<=l[i-1])){ if(i-s>bl){ bl=i-s; bs=s; } s=i; } } return l.slice(bs,bs+bl); }
tasks.note: Returns the first longest strictly increasing contiguous run.

tasks.name: תת-סדרה עולה
tasks.src: l=>{ const n=l.length, d=[], p=[]; let b=-1; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ d[i]=1; p[i]=-1; for(let j=0;j<i;j++) if(l[j]<l[i]&&d[j]+1>d[i]){ d[i]=d[j]+1; p[i]=j; } if(b<0||d[i]>d[b]) b=i; } const r=[]; while(b>=0){ r.unshift(l[b]); b=p[b]; } return r; }
tasks.note: Returns a longest increasing subsequence, built from earliest predecessors.

tasks.name: יש משלים
tasks.note: Keeps elements whose partner summing to 23 is also present.

tasks.name: קרוב לראשון
tasks.note: Sorts by distance from the first element, ties by value.

tasks.name: מחסנית יורדת
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[]; for(const x of l){ while(s.length&&s[s.length-1]<x) s.pop(); s.push(x); } return s; }
tasks.note: Keeps what remains on a stack where each new element pops smaller ones.

tasks.name: דילוג על זוגיות חוזרת
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(const x of l) if(!r.length||x%2!==r[r.length-1]%2) r.push(x); return r; }
tasks.note: Greedily keeps elements that alternate parity, skipping mismatches.

tasks.name: שרשרת קפיצות
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; let i=0; while(i<l.length){ r.push(l[i]); i+=l[i]%3+1; } return r; }
tasks.note: Collects elements visited by hopping forward by each value modulo 3 plus one.

tasks.name: בלי הזוג הכבד
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return [...l]; let b=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if(l[i]+l[i+1]>l[b]+l[b+1]) b=i; return [...l.slice(0,b),...l.slice(b+2)]; }
tasks.note: Removes the adjacent pair with the largest sum.

tasks.name: לפי שכיחות שארית
tasks.note: Groups elements by remainder mod 3, most common group first, keeping order inside groups.
